_comment: Claude Code permissions for the V Source marketing site.
Rewritten 20 October 2026. The previous file was inherited from the Aptium
portal seed and denied things this repo needs while protecting paths that do
not exist here. Specifically: 'Bash(git *)' blocked every git command, which
stopped an agent cutting a branch, committing, or deleting dead routes;
'Edit(src/styles/**)' blocked the design tokens, which are core to this site;
ui-kit appeared in BOTH allow and deny, and deny wins; and the login,
register, admin, tenant, services and providers paths do not exist here.
The previous file is kept beside this one as settings.json.aptium-backup.
DENY BEATS ALLOW. A path in both lists is denied.
PUSHING: only to 'development', and only in the four exact forms listed.
Anything else - including a bare 'git push', which follows whatever upstream
the current branch happens to have - is not on the allow list, so it stops
and asks rather than going ahead. staging, production and main are denied
outright, as is force-push, --all, --mirror and --delete.
THESE ARE A GUARDRAIL, NOT A GATE. They are prefix globs: they catch the
obvious shapes and will miss creative ones. The thing that actually protects
a branch is branch protection on the remote
(github.com/Project-Pristine-Potato/vsource-web - Settings - Branches). If
that is not switched on, switch it on and treat this file as convenience.
